assumptions_made: The original dataset from gretelai/synthetic_text_to_sql does not contain the structured grouped observations needed for this experiment, so we synthesized data that matches the requirements.
We assume that the experiment should focus on the variance comparison between estimators rather than the specific content of the SQL data.
We use a simplified shrinkage estimator based on the James-Stein estimator for demonstration purposes.
We set a fixed number of replicates (1000) and heterogeneity levels (5) to ensure the experiment completes within the time budget.
We assume that the group sizes (10, 20, 50) provide sufficient variation to observe differences in estimator performance.
We use a fixed within-group variance of 1.0 for simplicity and consistency.
We use a 95% confidence interval for coverage calculations.
